review.rationale: The Decision strictly authorizes one bounded local read-only diagnostic with exactly four local config reads (curl version, scutil --dns, scutil --proxy, proxy env presence), exactly two DNS lookups (system resolver and dig A for redcrag.cn), zero HTTP, zero SSH, zero server access or writes, zero network or proxy changes, zero retries/fallbacks, and explicit prohibitions on credential values and specific proxy-product inference without direct evidence. Caps and stop conditions enforce these limits, classification and result contracts are well-scoped, and status elevation (production/standard/commercial/release) is explicitly denied. Recommendation chain references and remote verification are present, preserving authority boundaries.
